defects.what: The picture is split by a hard horizontal line into two panels: a rainy street scene on top and a sketchbook page on the pavement below.
The open notebook in the center shows five lines of large handwritten pseudo-text that does not spell the script's Tagalog riddle.
The giant medallion in the center has garbled raised lettering ('MOIK KIN BHI GH', 'NO IOND') around its rim.
The two open books in the foreground are filled with large pseudo-text lines and a heading instead of a blank or correct Morga page.
A comic speech bubble with a '?' floats in the middle of the sky, and the copper plate rim and book cover in the crate carry pseudo-lettering.
Indio has no topknot and wears a dark zip jacket instead of the grey ukay hoodie seen in the shots around it.
In this Usman close-up both ears stand fully upright; neither ear is folded.
